hook: Har department ka [[Hero]] kaun? SQL se nikalo bhai

slides.title: Sawaal kya [[hai]]?
points: Har **department** se sabse zyada salary wala employee
Agar tie ho toh **dono** aane chahiye
slides.note: Bole toh: Office ka **'Employee of the Month'** har team se! 🎯

slides.title: Sample Table: [[employees]]
slides.note: IT mein Aarav aur Kabir dono ki **highest salary** 90k hai ⚡

slides.title: Asli [[Query]]
slides.code:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT name, dept, salary,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY dept
      ORDER BY salary DESC
    ) as rnk
  FROM employees
)
SELECT name, dept, salary
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;
slides.note: DENSE_RANK use karo taaki [[ties]] miss na ho bhai! 🤝

slides.title: Clause by Clause [[Breakdown]]
points: **PARTITION BY dept**: Har dept ko alag tod do
**ORDER BY salary DESC**: Amir log sabse upar
slides.note: Simple funda: Pehle ranking do, phir [[filter]] karo! 🧠

slides.title: Ranked Result: [[steps]]
slides.note: Jahan [[rnk = 1]] hai, wo hamara final output table banega ✨

slides.title: Final [[Output]]
slides.note: Neha gayab kyunki uska rank [[2]] tha, top earner nahi 🚫

slides.wrong: GROUP BY dept with MAX(salary) -- naam nahi milega
slides.right: DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY salary DESC)
slides.why: GROUP BY se sirf max salary milti hai, employee ka [[naam]] gayab ho jata hai! ⚠️

points: Har dept ka [[top earner]] nikalna = classic interview q
**PARTITION BY** dept se team alag hoti hai
